import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Insights - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color='steelblue')
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
# Order by age
age_order = ['0-Jährige', '1-Jährige', '2-Jährige', '3-Jährige', '4-Jährige', 
             '5-Jährige', '6-Jährige', '7-Jährige', '8-Jährige', '9-Jährige',
             '10-Jährige', '11-Jährige', '12-Jährige', '13-Jährige', '14-Jährige',
             '15-Jährige', '16-Jährige', '17-Jährige', '18-Jährige', '19-Jährige', '20-Jährige']
age_data = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex([a for a in age_order if a in df['AlterVHundLang'].unique()], fill_value=0)
ax2.bar(range(len(age_data)), age_data.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Registered Dogs', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_data)))
ax2.set_xticklabels([str(i) for i in range(len(age_data))], fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Dogs per District
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(district_counts))
district_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('District (Kreis)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Dog Population by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=9)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Gender Distribution - Dogs vs Owners
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
dog_gender = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
owner_gender = df['SexLang'].value_counts()

x = range(2)
width = 0.35

dog_male = dog_gender.get('männlich', 0)
dog_female = dog_gender.get('weiblich', 0)
owner_male = owner_gender.get('männlich', 0)
owner_female = owner_gender.get('weiblich', 0)

bars1 = ax4.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], [dog_male, dog_female], width, 
                label='Dogs', color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax4.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], [owner_male, owner_female], width,
                label='Owners', color='lightcoral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)

ax4.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Gender Distribution: Dogs vs Owners', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(['Male (männlich)', 'Female (weiblich)'], fontsize=10)
ax4.legend(fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add values on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                f'{int(height):,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
